+
+def make_response(content, status=200, encoding=None):
+    response = requests.Response()
+    response._content = content
+    response.status_code = status
+    response.encoding = encoding
+    response.url = 'https://example.org/record'
+    return response
+
+
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_passes_options_and_decodes_utf8(monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+
+    def get(url, **kwargs):
+        calls.append((url, kwargs))
+        return make_response('café'.encode('utf-8'))
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', get)
+    response = get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org/record',
+                                          headers={'Range': 'bytes=0-5'}, timeout=3)
+    assert calls == [('https://example.org/record',
+                      {'headers': {'Range': 'bytes=0-5'}, 'timeout': 3})]
+    assert response.text == 'café'
+
+
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_retries_and_raises_terminal_http_errors(monkeypatch):
+    responses = iter([make_response(b'', 500), make_response(b'ok')])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', lambda *args, **kwargs: next(responses))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia, 'sleep', lambda seconds: None)
+    assert get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org/record').content == b'ok'
+
+    for status in (403, 404, 416):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get',
+                            lambda *args, **kwargs: make_response(b'', status))
+        with pytest.raises(requests.exceptions.HTTPError) as error:
+            get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org/record')
+        assert error.value.response.status_code == status
+
+
+def test_get_from_archive_bulk_uses_range(monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+
+    def fetch(url, headers=None):
+        calls.append((url, headers))
+        return make_response(b'00010abcde00005')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia, 'urlopen_keep_trying', fetch)
+    data, offset, length = get_ia.get_from_archive_bulk('item/file.mrc:0:10')
+    assert calls == [(get_ia.IA_DOWNLOAD_URL + 'item/file.mrc',
+                      {'Range': 'bytes=0-14'})]
+    assert data == b'00010abcde'
+    assert (offset, length) == (10, 5)
+
+
+def test_get_from_archive_bulk_truncates_response(monkeypatch):
+    content = b'99999' + b'x' * 99994 + b'00005' + b'extra'
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia, 'urlopen_keep_trying',
+                        lambda url, headers=None: make_response(content))
+    data, offset, length = get_ia.get_from_archive_bulk('item/file.mrc:0:99999')
+    assert len(data) == 99999
+    assert (offset, length) == (None, None)
+
+
+def test_files_and_marc_formats_parse_response_content(monkeypatch):
+    xml = (b'<files><file name="item_meta.mrc"><size>10</size></file>'
+           b'<file name="item_marc.xml"/></files>')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia, 'urlopen_keep_trying',
+                        lambda url: make_response(xml))
+    assert list(get_ia.files('item')) == [('item_meta.mrc', 10)]
+    assert get_ia.marc_formats('item') == {'xml': True, 'bin': True}
+
